name: Template - Copy this folder to add a new exam

_instructions.prompts: Create .txt files in prompts/: free_chat.txt, scoring.txt, and part3_examiner.txt. Keep live examiner behavior separate from post-test scoring. Use {{RUBRICS}} in scoring.txt.
_instructions.questions: Create .json files in the questions/ folder. Structure depends on your exam's part system.
_instructions.rubrics: Create .json files in the rubrics/ folder. The scoring prompt will receive the full content.
